question: मातंस २०१८/प्र.क्र.४५/से-१/का.३९: who represents Land Records for the Mumbai Suburban District on the blockchain working group?
gold_answer: The District Superintendent, Land Records, Mumbai Suburban District, per the corrigendum of 31-07-2019. The original GR of 11-04-2019 named the Director, Land Records (Suburbs), Bandra. The later corrigendum of 04-10-2019 changed only the health member, not this one

product.answer: The 11-04-2019 GR lists the Director, Land Records, Fort, Mumbai as a member, and the Director, Land Records (Suburban), Bandra (East), Mumbai as a member, for the Land Records working group. The 31-07-2019 GR amends those memberships by replacing the Director, Land Records, Fort, Mumbai with the Deputy Director, Land Records, Konkan Region, Fort, Mumbai, replacing the Director, Land Records (Suburban) with the District Superintendent, Land Records, Mumbai Suburban District, and replacing the District Superintendent with the Town Geo Assessment Officer, Vile Parle. For the Mumbai Suburban District specifically, the District Superintendent, Land Records, Mumbai Suburban District is the representative.
